reference: Each review is tokenized, stop words are removed and every word is reduced to its stem with the Porter stemmer, so running and runs become the same word. TF-IDF then turns each review into a vector where a word's frequency is multiplied by its inverse document frequency, so words found in many reviews count for less. A Multinomial Naive Bayes classifier uses Bayes' theorem, assuming words are independent given the class, and picks the sentiment with the highest probability. Accuracy is measured on the held-out test reviews.
